from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); root=p.parents[2]
def digest(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# Narrow the Git claim to the shared worktree; isolated fixture Git is test behavior.
path=p/"README.md"
current,marker,historical=path.read_text().partition("## Preserved MB42 handoff and historical reports")
assert marker
path.write_text(current.replace("git mutation", "worktree git mutation")+marker+historical)
path=p/"context_save_mb43.md"
path.write_text(path.read_text().replace("git mutation", "worktree git mutation"))
from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location,module_from_spec
spec=spec_from_file_location("report",p/"verify_readme_mb43.py")
report=module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(report); report.main()
entry=json.loads((p/"mb43_entry_snapshot.json").read_text())
changed_names=("README.md","activation_plan_v2.md","host_commands.sh","host_commands.md","pins_v2.sha256","pins_v2.json","bulk_not_in_git_sha256.json")
existing=[]
for name in changed_names:
    path=p/name; before=p/"before"/("mb43_"+name)
    assert digest(before)==entry["hashes"][str(path.relative_to(root))]
    existing.append(dict(path=str(path.relative_to(root)),before_copy=str(before.relative_to(root)),before_sha256=digest(before),after_sha256=digest(path),size=path.stat().st_size))
new=[dict(path=str(x.relative_to(root)),before_sha256="ABSENT",after_sha256=digest(x),size=x.stat().st_size) for x in sorted(p.rglob("*")) if x.is_file() and str(x.relative_to(root)) not in entry["hashes"] and not str(x.relative_to(p)).startswith("commands/mb43_seal_prepare/")]
with (p/"change_manifest_mb43.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(dict(existing=existing,new=new,protected=entry["protected"],excluded_own_inflight="commands/mb43_seal_prepare/; sealed by final_sha256_mb43.txt after capture closes"),f,indent=2); f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(dict(result="SEAL_PREPARED",changed_existing=len(existing),new_entries=len(new),README_sha256=digest(p/"README.md"))))
